title: Happy-Go-Lucky Days
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A two-volume anthology by Takako Shimura (Wandering Son) of linked short stories about young people's love and sexual relationships in Japan (AniList; MangaUpdates). Stories include a woman who meets another woman at the wedding of a girl both once loved, a teacher at an all-boys school and a student's confession, and childhood friends whose bodies and feelings change through adolescence. A 2020 anime film adapted several stories (Beneath the Tangles).
life_message: All loves and ways of living have equal value, and even painful love becomes a tender memory (AniList blurb).

content.note: Ghost appears in one story (AniList tag).
